regions.name: Raga, Western Bahr el Ghazal State, South Sudan

sensor: Aqua MODIS (MCD14 C6.1 / NRT), confidence >= 30%, static sources removed
rule: 30-day outlook per 0.5° cell, Aqua MODIS only (one sensor since 2003, so no cross-sensor step). season: the next 30 days usually bring at least 5 hotspots (median of earlier years). above: the last 30 days are at or above the 90th percentile of the same days in earlier years and at least 5 hotspots. watch: both at once. rising: the usual next 30 days are at least twice the usual last 30.
caveat: Climatological outlook: what the next 30 days usually bring, and how unusual the last 30 days were against the same days since 2003. Not a forecast of weather or fire, and not an official alert. Hotspots are satellite detections, not confirmed fires; recent days are near-real-time. Aqua's orbit has drifted since 2022, which can shift recent counts; for one area, its harmonized record (all five satellites) is the reference.
